notes_for_editor: Story is mostly about the community, because the tower itself has only the 2016 list entry and an undated Forest Lookouts list entry; neither gives an agency, date, design or status for Fickling Mill. The list point (32.629722, -84.187770) is about 3 km south-southwest of the Wikipedia coordinates for the community (32.65417, -84.17778), so the shared name does not prove the tower sits at the mill. The story does not claim that it does. The list gives no elevation unit, so the story flags feet as an assumption. The 'topo' tag in the list is not explained on the page and is not used. The 2017 blog is used only for the pond and dam it describes. The story is about 145 words, which meets the 120-word floor, but the second paragraph is community and mill history rather than tower history; the editor may want it cut if it reads as padding.
